About this Event

90s Bollywood Ladies Night 💃✨Friends for Ghousia invites you to a fabulous 90s Bollywood Ladies Night!
Join us for an evening of retro Bollywood glamour, music, dancing, delicious food, exciting games, and wonderful company!
Dress as your favorite 90s Bollywood star and participate in our Bollywood Look-Alike Contest for a chance to win exciting prizes!
Event Details
Date: Friday, December 18, 2026Time: 5:00 PM onwardsLocation: 4265 White Eagle Dr, Naperville, ILTickets: $50 per person — food included!Bring your girlfriends, dress to impress, and get ready for a memorable evening of Bollywood nostalgia, laughter, and fun!
Hosted by Friends for Ghousia
